descriptions.en: The unwavering Bow of the school of Madurai. To face its wielder is to fight against its Tauron Strike, the tempestuous power of the Void itself; and there it has been lost since time immemorial.
descriptions.zh: （英文：THARA）Madurai 学派的无畏之弓。与它的持有者对抗，就如同与它的 Tauron 打击对抗，那是虚空本身狂暴的力量；而它自古以来就遗失在那里。

descriptions.en: The incisive Blade of the school of Naramon. A sword that cleaves fate as cleanly as its Tauron Strike would any mountain, should it ever be discovered in the vastness of the Void.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VEXORIC）Naramon 学派的利剑。若它有朝一日能在浩瀚的虚空中被发现，这把剑能像它的 Tauron 打击一样，一击断山、斩断命运。

descriptions.en: The mighty Hammer of the school of Unairu. Now lost to the Void, but if found, its Tauron Strike would be granted strength enough to topple armies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：COGRON）Unairu 学派的强大战锤。如今已遗失于虚空，但若能寻回，其 Tauron 打击将拥有足以摧毁军队的威力。

descriptions.en: The righteous Staff of the school of Vazarin. Before being lost to the Void, it was a weapon whose very presence could signal the end to a conflict, such is the destructive power of its Tauron Strike.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NIDRI）Vazarin 学派的正义之杖。在被虚空吞噬之前，它曾是一件武器，其存在本身就能预示着一场冲突的结束，这就是它的 Tauron 打击所具有的破坏力。

descriptions.en: The overpowering Grimoire of the school of Zenurik was perhaps ever destined for the Void. Though powerful, the ruinous secrets it whispers through its Tauron Strike can drive even the clearheaded to madness.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LORAK）Zenurik 学派那本威力无比的魔典或许注定要坠入虚空。尽管它力量强大，但它通过 Tauron 打击所低语出的毁灭性秘密，足以将头脑清醒之人逼入疯狂。
